description: Why VC and PE exist as their own asset classes, what verifying a client's accredited investor status actually requires of the advisor of record (506(b) self-certification vs. 506(c) mandatory verification), and how to recognize and navigate the family-office conversation — including the SEC's 2011 Family Office Rule and real 2026 SFO/MFO cost and AUM-threshold data. Written from the advisor's own practice/compliance perspective, distinct from the retail plugin's investor-facing version of this same subject.
name: vc_pe.deep_dive_track
title: Venture Capital & Private Equity — Access, Verification, and the Family Office Question
